snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Guns & Looting Showcase | Patch 1.5
snippet.description:
The Zone shapes and evolves — and so does S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl with the Guns & Looting update!

 Snipe the dangers with the new Three-line rifle and make use of the sidearm Kora. Hunt mutants for sample parts and immerse deeper into the Zone with expanded A-Life systems — where NPCs roam, survive, and die far out of your view. New car wrecks scatter the landscape, and anomalous electric vortexes stir the water that was calm before.

And also: QoL tweaks, improved Ukrainian lipsync, bigger stashes, and official modding support via Zone Kit… Good hunting at exploring by yourselves, stalkers!

More at: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1643320/view/525346350588494399
